# Prava Labs

> Prava Labs, LLC is an independent software studio building local-first, private-by-design apps and on-device AI tools. Products are grouped by where they run: on your phone (TradeSocial, BoatNavi; Mavee and Pravida in labs), on your Mac (Toolport), and in your own tenant (EAG, Loom).

## Products

- [Toolport](https://pravalabs.app/toolport/) — live: the semantic MCP tool registry — one local broker between any AI agent and all your MCP servers
- [TradeSocial](https://pravalabs.app/tradesocial/) — live: group paper trading with real market data (iOS)
- [EAG — Enterprise Agent Gateway](https://pravalabs.app/eag/) — coming soon: governed MCP gateway with identity-scoped, audited tools for enterprise systems
- [Prava Loom](https://pravalabs.app/loom/) — coming soon: the self-writing, self-healing integration agent — authors, custodies and heals the connections AI agents need, inside your tenant
- [Mavee](https://pravalabs.app/mavee/) — in development: Apple Intelligence day planner (iOS)
- [Pravida](https://pravalabs.app/pravida/) — in development: E2E-encrypted, invite-only private network (iOS)
- [BoatNavi](https://pravalabs.app/boatnavi/) — in development: clearance charts for your boat — charted depth plus tide, minus your draft and margin — offline-first for San Francisco Bay and the Delta (iOS, iPadOS)
